# FlowBuddy

> FlowBuddy is an in-app, context-aware AI assistant for SaaS products. A founder shows FlowBuddy their product once (a recorded demo); FlowBuddy turns it into an approved knowledge base and a custom AI assistant embedded in the product with one script tag — answering user questions, unblocking stuck users by highlighting their next step on the page, and walking them through whole tasks. Live in about 30 minutes, no coding required.

Key facts:

- The assistant answers only from workflows the founder recorded and approved. It shows the source behind every answer and honestly says "I don't know yet" instead of guessing when something isn't covered.
- It is context-aware: it knows which page the user is on and can highlight the exact next step directly in the product's interface.
- Three live capabilities, named on the page as: **In-App AI Assistant** (conversational help inside the product), **Contextual Guidance** (reads the page the user is on and highlights their next step), and **Interactive Walkthroughs** (guides a user through a whole task, one step at a time — the user stays in control; the assistant never acts for them).
- The homepage states this as "Record once. Use it everywhere.": one recording produces one approved knowledge base — a centralised product intelligence layer — and every consumer reads from it. Live today: the three capabilities above. In development and NOT yet available, named on the page as: **Autogenerated Help Portal**, **SOP Generation**, and **Knowledge Base for AI Agents**.
- Setup: record a product demo with the FlowBuddy Chrome recorder → FlowBuddy automatically creates product knowledge and step-by-step workflows → the founder reviews and approves them → embed one small script tag to go live.
- Works with any web app. The assistant is a floating overlay and never changes the host product's pages or layout. Its accent color can match the host brand.
- Privacy and safety: sensitive data is masked in the browser during recording before anything is uploaded; the embed key is public-safe, restricted to allowlisted domains, and rotatable.
- Pricing: free during early access; no credit card required.
- Outcomes it is bought for: in-app user assistance, faster onboarding, higher activation, fewer support tickets.

## Pages

- [Home](https://flowbuddyai.com/): what FlowBuddy is · how it works (record → approve → go live) · "Record once. Use it everywhere." — the one knowledge base and the six consumers it feeds, three live and three in development · outcomes · FAQ
- [FAQ](https://flowbuddyai.com/faq): the full question set — what FlowBuddy is and how it differs from chatbots, help centers and product tours; how it learns a product from one recording; setup and installation; accuracy, recording privacy and data handling; support-ticket, onboarding and activation impact; where AI-agent access is heading
- [The road ahead](https://flowbuddyai.com/future): FlowBuddy's direction — one approved knowledge base serving the in-app assistant today, with a hosted help portal and AI-agent access to the same knowledge in development (not yet available)
